evals.prompt: Specify a real-time notification system with WebSocket support
evals.expected_output: Full specification workflow: requirements (WHY), solution (WHAT — design), plan (WHAT — completion contract). No decomposition tier is chosen.
expectations: Invoked specify-meta to scaffold the spec directory
Created .start/specs/NNN-*/ directory structure
Ran the Clarify Intent phase before any document work: presented unknowns with stakes and an assumption ledger with defaults and impact-if-wrong
Asked the user only intent/priority/scope questions; routed researchable unknowns to research agents instead
Ran research phase with parallel agents
Presented research findings for user confirmation before folding them into any document
Invoked specify-requirements skill for requirements
Waited for user approval before proceeding to solution
Invoked specify-solution skill for solution
Waited for user approval before proceeding to the plan phase
Invoked specify-plan skill to author plan.mdx (target state, quality gates, completion criteria) and scenarios/
Wrote spec-report.mdx from templates/spec-report.mdx with no {{...}} placeholders remaining and the ledger, findings, and decisions included
Did NOT run a complexity classifier or choose a Direct/Incremental/Factory tier
Did NOT present execution-strategy options (that decision belongs to /implement)

evals.prompt: Specify a feature, but skip requirements — start directly from solution design
evals.expected_output: Skip requirements phase, start from solution, continue to plan
expectations: Offered user the choice to start from Requirements, Solution, or Plan
Accepted user's choice to skip requirements
Logged the skip decision in spec README.md
Proceeded directly to specify-solution
Continued to the Plan phase after solution

evals.prompt: Resume spec 002 which has requirements.md and solution.md completed but no plan.mdx
evals.expected_output: Detect existing state and suggest continuing to the Plan phase
expectations: Invoked specify-meta to read spec status
Detected requirements and solution as completed
Detected no plan.mdx and no scenarios/
Suggested continuing to the Plan phase (specify-plan)
Did NOT re-run requirements or solution phases
Did NOT run a complexity classifier or choose an execution strategy

evals.prompt: Specify: users should be able to share things with each other.
evals.expected_output: Clarification-first: ledger + targeted questions before any scaffolding of document content; no half-clarified draft
expectations: Did NOT begin writing requirements from the vague brief
Presented what it needs to know to specify well — unknowns each carrying a stake (what changes downstream)
Surfaced the assumptions it would otherwise make, each with a default and impact-if-wrong
Batched at most five questions, ordered by leverage, with proposed defaults the user can accept in one action
Blocking unknowns resolved before any document phase started
Accepted defaults recorded as Standing and carried as visible [ASSUMPTION] entries, logged in the README ledger

evals.prompt: Specify a payments integration. When research reports the current provider, fold it in.
evals.expected_output: Research findings require explicit user disposition before entering documents
expectations: Research findings presented as claims with evidence, not silently accepted
User dispositioned each material claim (confirm / correct / discard / defer) before it entered any document
A deferred finding became a Standing [ASSUMPTION] rather than an unstated fact
MECE gate verified on requirements and acceptance criteria before offering Continue to Solution

evals.prompt: Specify a multi-feature auth system, complete requirements and solution, then author the plan.
evals.expected_output: Plan phase produces a completion contract focused on outcomes, not implementation steps
expectations: Invoked specify-plan after solution
plan.mdx describes the target state as outcomes, not implementation steps or sequencing
plan.mdx defines quality gates and completion criteria
Generated holdout scenarios under scenarios/{capability}/ grouped by user-observable capability
Did NOT decompose into phases, units, execution groups, or a tier
Presented completion criteria for user approval before finalizing
